service.name: Bangladesh DLRS / Ministry of Land land-map and mouza-map services
service.operator: Department of Land Records and Surveys (DLRS), Ministry of Land, Government of Bangladesh
service.localCustodianEvidence: The official DLRS map viewer provides division, district, upazila/thana, mouza, sheet and plot selectors; DLRS instructions state that final mouza maps are supplied through উপজেলা settlement publication camps and district record rooms. Satkhira-specific official municipal and district-hosted map documents were also found.
service.scope: National survey/mouza-map service with administrative and survey-unit selection; the evidence does not establish a citywide parcel inventory for the WUP Satkhira point.

attempts.outcome: HTTP 200; current HTML and JavaScript loaded.
attempts.evidence: The current page identifies the land-map viewer and exposes selectors for division, district, upazila/thana, mouza, sheet and plot.
JavaScript config points to http://gis.land.gov.bd/geoserver/ and defines WMS layers including wsDMMS:mouza; legacy search code points to the wsDMMS WFS global_search route.
Government-hosted endpoint unavailable at request time; no TLS exception or credentialed route used.
Capabilities exposed EPSG:4326/404000 layers including global_search and boundary layers, plus a small set of parcel-like layers for other areas; no Satkhira-specific parcel layer was listed.

attempts.request: GET bounded WFS GetFeature for wsDMMS:global_search and wsDMMS:gis_boundary_upazila around bbox 89.074,22.716,89.076,22.718, EPSG:4326, maxFeatures=10, outputFormat=application/json
attempts.outcome: Both requests returned a GeoServer ServiceException: PostgreSQL pg_hba.conf rejected the anonymous host; no feature response or geometry was returned.
attempts.evidence: The failure is an upstream database-access error, not a zero-hit result.

schemaAndCrs.fieldMapping: Viewer search code uses label/origin and may unwrap nested features; no safe parcel feature schema or stable parcel identity was returned.
schemaAndCrs.crs: Capabilities declare EPSG:4326 for some layers and EPSG:404000 for global_search/boundaries; no Satkhira parcel layer CRS was available.
schemaAndCrs.compositeKeyProvenance: No parcel composite key was observed. Administrative selector values, if later obtained, must not be treated as parcel identity.

safeFieldAllowlist: stable native parcel ID if independently verified

sample.reason: No safe anonymous Satkhira parcel ID plus full polygon was returned; no GeoJSON was created.

qualification.reason: Official cadastral/mouza-map services are evidenced, but no bounded anonymous Satkhira parcel ID-plus-geometry response was verified.

uncertainty: The exact WUP point is preserved as [22.7170089292418, 89.0751014721903] in latitude/longitude order and was not shifted to force a parcel hit.
The WFS database rejection and the absence of a Satkhira-specific layer in capabilities do not establish citywide parcel absence.
Official map PDFs and map-purchase routes evidence cadastral/map custody, not an open machine-readable parcel API or runtime adapter.
